deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing gesture ('here') into the spatial description 'alongside it', which the lecturer did not state and which the text does not support.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Histologically, this is the endocervical canal here, and so you're looking at the cervix here.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and the cervix is seen alongside it
